name: Uraeus Counter-Edict Serpent
loreTies: A living legal curse from Aten Ra sanctums that marks oathbreakers and enemy scouts during cross-faction run-ins.
Applies accuracy and cooldown pressure while staying near landmarks.
source culture humans later copied as Egyptian solar myth
shortBackstory: Uraeus Counter-Edict Serpent is a lore-faithful Aten Ra run-in creature used when missions or events justify faction contact without rewriting the faction or creating playable squads.

chapters.title: Origin
chapters.text: Uraeus Counter-Edict Serpent belongs to The Solar Dominion of Khepra and exists to express Aten Ra law, pressure, or defense during Gate instability.

chapters.title: Faction Function
chapters.text: Applies accuracy and cooldown pressure while staying near landmarks.

chapters.title: Lore Guardrail
chapters.text: Do not use as a generic monster; keep faction law, materials, motives, and silhouette intact.

chapters.title: Campaign Use
chapters.text: It may appear in enemy-controlled zones, border conflicts, Gate events, pursuits, trials, bargains, or defensive reactions when the mission gives a lore-valid reason.

chapters.title: Visual / Encounter Rule
chapters.text: Visuals must follow: Solar cobra silhouette with Red Land jasper hood, hand-ray spine, and unreadable non-glyph light law. Abilities — Counter-Edict Spit, Blinding Crown, Law Venom — must telegraph clearly for mobile one-Deity-vs-many combat.

developmentStatus: Readable faction run-in creature profile integrated into mission/event encounter pools.
